0.original: Managingway is thinking it may be time to suit up.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Speak with Protectingway in Bestways Burrow.

2.original: Deliver the requested items to Managingway.

24.original: Speak with Protectingway in Bestways Burrow.

48.original: Ah, just the person I was looking for. Another bright-eyed dreamer has come to me seeking help─Protectingway.

49.original: Her dream is to see that all Loporrit-kind enjoy a long and healthy life abrim with safety. At present, she's hard at work on an invention to protect us from parasitic fungal spores─and the infectious diseases they can induce. Nasty stuff.

50.original: The moon's surface is full of all sorts of perils─inhale even one stray spore and we could find ourselves with a runny nose, rashes all over, or heavens, even loss of fur! If she can find some way to prevent such travesties from occurring, I for one would welcome it.

51.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Do you have a moment to spare? Protectingway has requested your aid once again.

52.original: It seems her invention─the parasital infection protection suit, or PIPS for short─works, and now she wishes to bolster its production.

53.original: For the sake of all Loporrits present and─well, present, I ask that you meet her in Bestways Burrow, and assist her with the production of this invaluable device.

54.original: Ah, hello there! I take it Managingway sent you here to assist me. Your help is much appreciated!

55.original: As Managingway undoubtedly informed you, I'm constructing a suit designed to shield the wearer from infectious spores. Unfortunately, I'm short on deft paws able to craft the most essential components─or rather I was, until you came.

56.original: It would be wonderful if you could use these spare metal parts to craft a fastener for the suit to ensure it stays airtight! Should you run out of materials, I'm just a hop, skip, and a jump away!

57.original: It would be wonderful if you could craft an airtight fabric for the suit─can't have it letting in the stray fungal matter, after all! Should you run out of materials, I'm just a hop, skip, and a jump away!

58.original: It would be wonderful if you could craft an adhesive to ensure the suit remains airtight! Should you run out of materials, I'm just a hop, skip, and a jump away!

59.original: When you've finished, please take the component to Managingway. I wish to implement it into the suit straightaway upon my return to the machining station!

60.original: What's that? You've run out of materials? But... I clearly see you holding them right there!

61.original: What's that? You've run out of materials? But... I clearly see you holding them right there!

62.original: What's that? You've run out of materials? But... I clearly see you holding them right there!

63.original: Run out of materials, have you? Not to worry, I've plenty more here.

64.original: Run out of materials, have you? Not to worry, I've plenty more here.

65.original: Run out of materials, have you? Not to worry, I've plenty more here.

66.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! How do matters fare with Protectingway?

67.original: Ah, I see you've already crafted the necessary material. If it were anyone else, I would be inclined to put this through several inspections─but I know we're in good paws with you. Protectingway will doubtless be thrilled.

68.original: Still, I wonder why she thought to create a protective suit. Rather than address a symptom of the problem, would it not be more effective to attack its source, and eradicate the infectious fungi in the first place?

69.original: Well, it is not for me to question the dream of another. My thanks for your kind assistance!
